prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: a single tightly cropped dialogue portrait for a grounded medieval RPG. Follow the approved Mara and Ivo portrait references for pixel cluster scale and serious human facial modeling. Do not copy either face.
The target canvas is 74 pixels wide by 100 pixels high. Design with that coarse logical grid: large opaque contiguous color clusters, hard stepped edges, strong coherent dark outer contour, sparse internal lines, warm matte skin volumes in nose wings, cheekbones and jaw. If the output must be larger, render the 74x100 logical grid as a crisp uniform integer enlargement, not a fine painting with a pixel filter. Maximum 32 opaque colors for this batch. No gradients, smooth shading, dithering, texture speckle, isolated bright pixels, glowing eyes, detailed strands, or tiny cross-hatching.
Composition: tightly cropped HEAD portrait, crown close to top edge, face filling most of frame, bottom cuts at upper collar, only narrow collar/shoulder slivers, no chest. Face and hair nearly fill width, subtle three-quarter angle. True transparent background outside head and collar silhouette. No border, panel, lettering, scene, props, hands or other people.
Input image roles: Image 1 is Rhea's existing identity silhouette and costume palette only; do not retain its chibi proportions, oversized eyes, or smooth face. Images 2 and 3 are the approved Mara and Ivo portrait style masters.
Subject: Rhea (蕾雅, n1_rhea), a mature adult woman who helps threatened families find temporary safety. She is clear-eyed and protective, not sweet or girlish. Keep her distinct broad trapezoid face and broad angular lower jaw, low rounded forehead, short wide blunt nose with substantial nostril wings, wide firmly compressed lips, thick fairly straight brows, small naturally proportioned wide-set eyes. Her eyes look carefully toward the listener just off to viewer-left, with a firm sober warning, a hint of tired under-eye crease and asymmetric brow tension. Adult planes around nose and mouth; not an elderly face, no deep new scars. Natural dark brown eyes with subdued whites and NO pinpoint glints.
Chestnut hair combed back with short blunt horizontal fringe above eyebrows, tied into one simple low knot behind the head. Hair organized into 4 or 5 broad solid locks, no curls or braids. At the very bottom show only a narrow faded dusty-blue wool shawl edge and practical gray linen/wool neckline, plain and worn. No jewelry, badges, magic, book, blanket or child. Preserve color identity but translate into warm skin light and warm-brown shadow masses, with the same visual weight as the approved portraits.
